framly.description:
AI-powered SaaS studio for short-form video creation.

  • Problem: Producing a compelling short video requires editing, voiceover and motion design skills most creators don't have.
  • Solution: A multi-step wizard turns a plain-text brief into a publish-ready video — automatic storyboard, AI voiceover, image and clip generation, captions and final MP4 assembly.
  • Impact: From brief to TikTok/Shorts-ready video in minutes, with no editing software or technical skills required.

deviscope.description:
AI-powered SaaS platform for auditing construction quotes.

  • Problem: Homeowners have no reliable way to assess quote fairness — inflated prices, unvetted contractors, no accessible benchmark.
  • Solution: GPT-4o Vision parses PDF quotes, SIRENE/BODACC/ADEME APIs verify contractor compliance, and a hybrid AI + business logic engine generates a region-adjusted reference budget.
  • Impact: Live at deviscope.fr — delivers in seconds the analysis a professional would take hours to produce manually.

rts.description:
Age of Empires I recreated in pure JavaScript, no game engine.

  • Challenge: Rebuild a full RTS from scratch — 2D rendering, AI, pathfinding, resource management — without any game framework.
  • Solution: Custom engine on top of PixiJS: tile maps, fog of war, unit selection, resource gathering, building construction and basic AI.
  • Result: Ongoing project, playable online — showcases low-level rendering, performance, and custom game engine architecture.

kiki.description:
3D gameplay mechanics experimentation with Babylon.js.

  • Challenge: Explore intelligent navigation on procedurally generated 3D terrain — variable relief, hills, trees — without a dedicated pathfinding library.
  • Solution: Procedural terrain generation with an A* algorithm adapted to 3D relief, mouse-driven creature movement for smooth interaction.
  • Result: Functional prototype demonstrating complex 3D terrain management and gameplay logic integration in a modern engine.

supfile.description:
Web application for hosting and sharing files.

  • Problem: Sharing large files between students was painful — email attachments, expiring links, no organization.
  • Solution: VueJS + Laravel stack with multi-type file upload, interactive file tree (rename, move, delete), and persistent shareable links.
  • Result: 6-month project — complete client/server architecture with access management and data persistence.

awale.description: Awalé is an African game from the Mancala family. It is a strategic game where the goal is to collect the most seeds. The objective of this project was to develop an artificial intelligence with three difficulty levels.

battleship.description:
Real-time multiplayer Battleship built in a 2-week school sprint.

  • Challenge: Recreate a synchronized multiplayer game with social features under a very tight deadline.
  • Solution: NodeJS + SocketIO to sync game state in real time, integrated global chat, and a friends system for private matches.
  • Result: Fully playable online game — demonstrates WebSocket mastery and server-side state synchronization.

weathermap.description: WeatherMap is an application that allows users to quickly and easily check the weather worldwide. By clicking on the map or searching for a city, users get the weather information for the selected region. It is also possible to save cities or regions as favorites for a dedicated view.

biblio.description: Biblio is a tool to manage book rentals in a library. Users can manage both books and borrowers, create or close rentals, and view rental history for each book or user.

supinfy.description: Supinfy is a music streaming application. Users can listen to music, manage their playlists once logged in, and search for other users' playlists. A contact system allows adding friends and staying updated on their latest playlists. Administrators can manage users and select playlists to feature on the homepage.

qwirk.description:
Cross-platform communication app (Windows, macOS, Linux).

  • Challenge: Build a full-featured communication tool in 6 months, on par with professional apps on the market.
  • Solution: NodeJS + SocketIO for real-time messaging, WebRTC for audio/video calls, full contact management, public/private groups, file sharing, and profile customization.
  • Result: Robust event-driven architecture with encrypted, persistent conversations — feature set comparable to Slack or Discord.

imap.description: This application helps locate a position quickly. Useful for finding your car in a large parking lot, locating your tent at a music festival, or discovering interesting places in a city you encounter by chance.

supsale.description: Supsale is a classified ads website similar to Amazon or Leboncoin. Visitors can search for ads using a search engine and contact sellers via a form. Logged-in users can post ads in various categories and manage them. Administrators can manage both users and ads.

symfony.description: Developed a website for a company to sell products online. Visitors can search for items. Logged-in users can add products to their cart, complete purchases, and receive a confirmation email. Users can view their purchase history and track shipments. Sellers can add, edit, or remove products in categories.

cakeblog.description: Cakeblog is an online blog. The blog author can create, modify, or delete articles and manage visitor comments. Visitors can leave one or more comments under a pseudonym and contact the author via a contact form.

freefallin.description:
Solo 2D mobile game developed end-to-end in 4 months.

  • Challenge: Self-taught on GML, ship a complete mobile game solo — procedural generation, gyroscope controls, full progression mechanics.
  • Solution: Randomly generated world, dynamic obstacles, power-up system, progressive difficulty, score leaderboard, and Facebook sharing.
  • Result: Published and fully playable — proves the ability to deliver a complete product from scratch, entirely outside any school framework.

easyhome.description: EasyHome is a real estate agency website. Visitors can view listings filtered by their preferences. Logged-in users can request appointments to visit properties, optionally specifying a date, and manage their requests. They can also suggest adding new properties. All requests are emailed to the sellers, who can add listings and manage appointments via a dedicated space.

about.bio: Lead Full Stack Developer with over 7 years of experience designing, scaling and securing complex, business-critical web applications. Strong expertise in modern JavaScript architectures (React, Node.js, TypeScript), large-scale codebase structuring and automation of critical business processes.
